# monerometrics

> A free, reorg-aware observatory of the Monero (XMR) network. It measures chain
> reorganizations, orphan blocks, network hashrate, block time, mempool state and
> mining-pool centralization, and serves everything through a public read-only API.

monerometrics runs its own Monero node, indexes every block as it arrives, and
detects chain reorganizations by re-checking a rolling window of recent blocks
against the node. Mining-pool attribution is verified, not guessed: where a pool
publishes its wallet view key, the coinbase output is checked cryptographically
(view-key proof); attribution is also cross-checked against the pools' own public
block lists, never inferred from a pool's self-reported hashrate. Blocks matching
no known pool are reported as `unknown`.

The interactive chain fork visualizer covers the whole chain: you can search any
block height or block hash and jump straight to it, all the way down to the
genesis block, with lazy loading so it stays fast.

No account, no API key, no rate-limit tiers, no tracking, no ads.

## API

- [OpenAPI schema](https://api.monerometrics.net/openapi.json): full machine-readable API description
- [Health](https://api.monerometrics.net/health): service liveness
- [Network info](https://api.monerometrics.net/network/info): height, difficulty, hashrate, mempool
- [Network hashrate](https://api.monerometrics.net/network/hashrate): time series, window=1h|24h|7d|30d|90d|1y|5y
- [Block time](https://api.monerometrics.net/network/blocktime): block-time variance time series
- [Mempool](https://api.monerometrics.net/network/mempool): mempool size time series
- [Emission](https://api.monerometrics.net/network/emission): block reward time series
- [Reorgs](https://api.monerometrics.net/reorgs): detected chain reorganizations
- [Reorg stats](https://api.monerometrics.net/reorgs/stats): reorg counts, depth, affected transactions
- [Recent orphans](https://api.monerometrics.net/orphans/recent): recent orphan blocks
- [Chain window](https://api.monerometrics.net/chain/window): canonical blocks in a height range
- [Fork window](https://api.monerometrics.net/chain/fork-window): canonical chain plus competing orphan blocks
- [Pool distribution](https://api.monerometrics.net/pools/distribution): mining-pool shares, largest-pool share, Nakamoto coefficient
- [Pool sources](https://api.monerometrics.net/pools/sources): reachability of each pool API used for attribution
